nom: Good Molecules Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report burning, redness, stinging, or a damaged barrier after use, while others (including two self-described very sensitive users) report no irritation, no fragrance issues, and good tolerance around the eyes.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe good hydration and a comfortable feel, though a few report the under-eye area becoming dry, stiff, or tight after continued use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (mid-30s to 60s) commonly report visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles, reduced puffiness, and a lightweight, non-greasy feel, with some noting no effect on discoloration.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin reports no visible improvement and a tacky, residue-leaving finish that shows under makeup.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoothed or less noticeable fine lines and wrinkles, especially around the eyes, with a couple explicitly framing this as an anti-aging effect; no dissent on this point among those who mention aging.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe good, lasting hydration and relief for patchy or dry under-eye skin; however, some report the opposite — increased dryness, stiffness, or a burning sensation after use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report redness developing after application, sometimes with burning or stinging, including on skin not usually reactive; no reviewer reports the product reducing pre-existing redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report barrier damage — burning, itching, swelling, or peeling lasting up to a week — attributed by one reviewer to a reformulation adding corn starch.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots and pigmentation under the eyes clearing gradually with continued use; another reports the product caused milia.
concerns.blemishes: A small number of reviewers mention milia or blemish-like bumps appearing after use, while at least one other reviewer notes the product did not cause milia unlike other eye creams they've tried.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the gel as non-greasy and lightweight; no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Tube packaging leaks or flakes paint

extraits.texte: This caused burning, redness, itching and swelling in the areas that I applied it. It damaged my skin barrier and probably took a good week or so for my skin to return to normal. I know everybody's skin is different, but something to watch out for. My skin doesn't normally react that way to products.

extraits.titre: This product is a steal. Great results.
extraits.texte: I'm 57 and have sensitive, dry, aging (ugh) skin. I've also been suffering from lots of puffiness under my eyes. I picked this up on a whim and have been super impressed - after a few weeks of use, my eye bags are definitely diminished and the lines under my eyes are also not as noticeable. I use this alone in the day, and layer it under a rich eye cream at night.

This is my favorite affordable eye gel. It feels instantly cooling, smoothed my fine lines, and hasn't broken out my sensitive skin around my eyes like other eye creams. With daily use, my under eye puffiness has been reduced by about half, and my moderate dark circles have improved similarly. For the price, it's absolutely worth trying.

I have extremely sensitive skin overall, especially around my eyes. I am very grateful there is no fragrance with this product and I have no sensitivity issues. It's more of a gel, but not heavy or oily. I'm 63 and my skin responds to my everyday usage. I use a very small amount, about the size of just the tip of a pencil eraser, and I tap it around the lower part of my eye. I've read positive results about people keeping it in the fridge to help with puffiness which makes sense, but I haven't tried that yet. As is, I'm really pleased with the results.

I have had dark spots under my eyes for a good while now. So wearing make-up was part of my daily routine as putting on clothes for work. When we were all facing Covid was when I stopped wearing it due to the mask. The ties always left a mark that showed where the ties were placed. It made me focus even more on the dark circles that I was trying to hide under my makeup. So I decided to try the MoLECULES serum not feeling 100% that it would work but it actually does. Day by day the pigmentation of my skin is clearing up. My eyes are not as puffy and the darkness in my skin is clearing up as well. I'm finally feeling less embarrassed day by day as I have continued my freedom choice of a non-makeup wearing day. The visual changes have people noticing my skin tone more and more. At the tender age of 63. My pimple blemishes are lighter than before and other spots are gone all together.

The eye gel was fine to use for the first like 2 to 4 days, but after that it started hurting to use. My under eye area is peeling and burns after using the gel, and a spot where I dabbed a tiny bit of excess on one of my eyelids is still red and irritated over a week later. Either this is only supposed to be used like once a week and the packaging needs to be updated to reflect that, or there might be something wrong with the formulation because I don't have sensitive skin, so a reaction like this is really unusual.
